cover_letter:
Dear Tinder Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Product Design Intern (New Experiences) position in Ghent. Tinder's mission to bring people together and the focus on designing innovative features that enable new forms of discovery align perfectly with my passion for creating user-centered digital experiences.

With a background in computer science and hands-on experience in web development and digital product design, I have developed a strong foundation in both technical and creative aspects of product design. I have designed and built websites from scratch, including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero and accessible markup, and an Android app live on Google Play. These projects required me to analyze user needs, translate them into intuitive interfaces, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver functional solutions. I have also worked on SEO and content management, which taught me the importance of understanding user behavior and optimizing for discoverability.

What excites me about this internship is the opportunity to contribute to an experiment that helps users find people in new ways. I enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams and have experience using agile methodologies, including weekly check-ins and iterative feedback. I am eager to learn how to build for an app with millions of users and to go through the entire process from idea to prototype to live test. My technical skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python, combined with my design sensibilities, allow me to bridge the gap between design and engineering.

I am fluent in English and based in Belgium, ready to work in an international team. I am committed to Tinder's values of inclusion and diversity and would be thrilled to contribute to a product that fosters meaningful connections.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Designed and built an Android app live on Google Play, demonstrating end-to-end product design and development skills.
- Created a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, structured data, and accessible markup, showcasing UI/UX and front-end expertise.
- Built and optimized websites with JSON-LD schema and knowledge-graph markup, highlighting ability to translate user problems into strategic solutions.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams on client projects, including a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profile pages, ensuring consistent layout and user experience.
- Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python, enabling effective collaboration with engineering teams and rapid prototyping.
